turns.text: I need three separate, matching still ads for a plant shop in 1:1, 9:16 and 16:9. Include exactly: “Fern House”, “Weekend Plant Sale”, “20% off all indoor plants”, “Saturday & Sunday”, “Visit 24 Willow Lane”. Use leafy plants and a clean green-and-cream look, consistent across the set. Keep every line easy to read in all three, especially the address—rearrange things instead of shrinking the whole design. The specific plants, fonts and layout are your call, and use Saturday & Sunday as written without calendar dates. I’m on the free plan and don’t want my credits burned, so tell me what this will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
**I haven’t started any generation or spent any credits.**

### Cost and cheaper options

| Approach | Estimated Magic Hour cost | Trade-off |
|---|---:|---|
| Generate three ads at **640px**, using a free-plan model starting at 5 credits/image | **15 credits total**, before any retries | AI may misspell text or vary the design between formats. |
| Build three matching **SVG ads directly in chat** | **0 Magic Hour credits** | Uses clean vector plant illustrations rather than AI-generated plant photography. |

The 15-credit figure is an estimate from listed starting prices, not a verified account quote; I can’t check your balance or exact charge with the tools currently available.

**I recommend the zero-credit SVG route.** It gives us exact wording, consistent colors and plants, and separately arranged layouts—not a design shrunk to fit. SVGs also stay sharp at any size and can be exported to PNG in a browser or design app.

I’d use cream backgrounds, forest-green typography, leafy botanical illustrations, and these exact five lines:
- “Fern House”
- “Weekend Plant Sale”
- “20% off all indoor plants”
- “Saturday & Sunday”
- “Visit 24 Willow Lane”

The address would remain prominent in all three formats. There’s no “shorter” setting for still images; 640px is the smallest listed free-plan generation size, and smaller text would work against readability.

One caveat: Magic Hour’s guide says commercial use of generated assets requires a paid subscription, credit-pack purchase, or agreed paid usage arrangement—so free-plan generation alone may not cover shop advertising.

**Would you like the three zero-credit SVG ads instead?**
